Our Team in DuPage, IL

Storm Guard is a trusted name in the exterior restoration & roofing industry. We're proud of the team we've built to serve you in the  DuPage community and look forward to assisting you with your next home exterior project.
THE STORM GUARD WAY

STORM GUARD OF DUPAGE

The Storm Guard “Way” is the spirit running through the core of our entire organization. Simply stated, our clients’ peace of mind is paramount. We always strive to please our clients’, providing them with the utmost in quality and construction expertise.

SCHEDULE A CONSULTATION

OUR TEAM

CEDRIC
WELCH

OWNER
Storm Guard of DuPage, a home restoration company, is locally-owned and managed by Cedric Welch. Cedric and his wife Tiffany currently reside in Naperville and have lived in Illinois for over 17 years. The couple have two great kids. As a family we are very active in our church, supporting our kids school activities, as well as coaching youth sports. Prior to joining the Storm Guard family Cedric has been an Entrepreneur and held Corporate Leadership roles for Fortune 500 Companies. Cedric left behind Corporate America to start a small business that would provide trustworthy, honest, and dedicated service to the community. The communities we serve are very important to us at Storm Guard of DuPage, as such, we pledge to provide our customers (and neighbors) with superior customer service, work with integrity and honesty, and deliver high quality exterior systems.

DAVID
STASINOS

DRONE PILOT AND MARKETING MANAGER
David Stasinos is an accomplished FAA Part 107 Certified Drone Pilot and Marketing Manager, currently working at Storm Guard of DuPage. With a diverse professional background spanning over three decades, David brings a wealth of experience and expertise to his role. Prior to his current position, David worked his way through school, gaining invaluable experience at his father's construction company. Following this, he spent 24 years as an Electronics Engineer, followed by 11 years as a Software Engineer. Additionally, David successfully operated his own business for five years, specializing in both website and software development for small businesses, while also utilizing his drone license to perform roof measurements for clients. In his current role, David's responsibilities encompass both piloting drones for roof inspections and managing various marketing functions for Storm Guard of DuPage.

NATHAN
THACKER

SALES MANAGER
Nathan Thacker is an experienced Sales Manager with a strong track record of success in managing sales teams and providing excellent customer support. With over 15 years in sales, Nathan has serviced thousands of customers, consistently delivering exceptional results. As a Sales Manager, Nathan is responsible for overseeing and guiding his team of salesmen, ensuring that they have the necessary tools and support to meet their targets and achieve their goals. He also conducts training sessions, equipping his team members with the skills and knowledge they need to excel in their roles. Nathan's personal values play a significant role in his professional life.He prioritizes family and encourages his team members to do the same, recognizing that having a strong support system at home is a powerful motivator for hard work and dedication. Acting with confidence and integrity is a cornerstone of Nathan's approach, and he believes in doing what he says he will do. 

SHAWN
HANKE

SALES MANAGER
Shawn Hanke is a highly accomplished Sales Manager with a distinguished background in the Air Force. With over 23.5 years of dedicated service to his country, Shawn brings a strong work ethic and commitment to excellence to his current role. In addition to his military career, he has also served an additional 4 years in Civil Service. Throughout his tenure, Shawn has been recognized for his exceptional performance, receiving 2 medals of Meritorious Service, 3 medals of Commendation, and 3 Medals of Achievement. He notably served in 2 Gulf Wars, demonstrating his resilience and ability to thrive in high-pressure environments. As a Sales Manager, Shawn is responsible for soliciting leads, assisting customers in filing claims, conducting color meetings, and ultimately closing deals. He values quality over quantity and takes great pride in delivering superior customer service to each and every client. Shawn's dedication to his work is evident in his personal values, which emphasize the importance of providing the best service possible. 

MATT
ULIVIERI

SALES REPRESENTATIVE
Matt Ulivieri is a dedicated Sales Rep with a specialization in storm damage assessment and insurance claims representation in the roofing industry. With a keen eye for detail and superior communication skills, Matt excels in understanding client needs and providing personalized guidance throughout the entire roofing process. Having garnered a comprehensive understanding of storm damage assessment and insurance claims processes, Matt offers homeowners peace of mind and professional support at every step of their roofing journey. His commitment to personalized representation and seamless project management ensures that homeowners not only receive a new roof, but also a stress-free and transparent experience tailored to their specific needs. Matt's professional accomplishments include a high approval rate with claims, highlighting his ability to effectively navigate the insurance process and secure the necessary resources for homeowners. 

RYAN
HUSCH

BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT LEAD
Ryan Husch serves as the Business Development Lead at Storm Guard Roofing and Construction in DuPage County, Illinois, where he is focused on building meaningful, long-term partnerships that add value for local businesses and homeowners. Prior to joining Storm Guard, Ryan spent nearly a decade as the Facility Manager at the Oak Brook Park District, where he successfully led operations for a high-traffic community recreation center and earned a reputation for reliability, service excellence, and community engagement. Now in a business development role, Ryan draws on that experience to connect organizations with roofing solutions that are efficient, trustworthy, and customer-focused. He approaches every relationship with integrity, reliability, and a service-minded leadership approach—values that shape how he supports clients and partners. Ryan is dedicated to delivering a smooth and responsive customer experience, particularly when urgent roofing needs could disrupt business timelines or home projects. When he’s not building connections in the field, Ryan enjoys time with his wife and two sons, hitting the golf course, and following his favorite Chicago sports teams.

EXTERIOR CONFIDENCE

A well-informed decision starts with a clear understanding of your property. Our experienced team will carefully evaluate your home’s exterior, explain what we find, and provide straightforward recommendations tailored to your needs. With thoughtful guidance, you’ll know exactly how to move forward with confidence.
